name: rotate-and-box
description: Rotation and boxing, on top of a full run to the Upgrade Bench. A grabber is placed facing north and turned three times round the compass; a Chip Kitchen is given two Speed levels and a Capacity level, jams, is whacked and repaired, and is then BOXED by errand with forty bags and six potatoes still in it — all of which come back to the player's hands — and put down again somewhere else for nothing, same dials, same invoice, money untouched. A second, plain kitchen is boxed at the machine rather than walked to, and scrapped for exactly 40% of its $100 invoice. Ends holding two boxes of one kind at two different invoices, so the canonical least-invested-first order inside a slot is in the digest, beside a Washer bought fresh and left part-way through an operation.
